FEAT-6-S132.title: Consent Core Logic Implementation
FEAT-6-S132.description: Implement ConsentService logic for two-tier HIPAA consent including tier evaluation, conversation summarization, de-identification (Safe Harbor), and enforcement of storage rules based on consent level.

FEAT-6-S133.title: Consent API and Tool Router Integration
FEAT-6-S133.description: Expose consent workflow through tool_router with validated inputs, ensuring consent capture, tier escalation prompts, and enforcement hooks are callable within chat flows.

FEAT-6-S134.title: Consent Integration with Lead Capture and Unknowns
FEAT-6-S134.description: Integrate consent workflow with lead_service and unknown_question_service to ensure Tier 2 consent is required before identifiable data storage and that de-identified flows are enforced otherwise.
